cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(test_package CXX)

# mitama-cpp-result is a C++20 header-only library.
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# CMakeDeps (generated by test_package/conanfile.py) provides this config.
find_package(mitama-cpp-result CONFIG REQUIRED)

add_executable(test_package test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(test_package PRIVATE mitama-cpp-result::mitama-cpp-result)
